note: Thresholds live here, not inline in the harness. They come from docs/CERTIFICATION.md §4 and move only with evidence attached -- the ratchet rule expects them to tighten, never to loosen so a failing run passes.

level_b.note: Certification spec §4 lists SSIM >= 0.98 as a Level B threshold; this harness gates on Level A only and records SSIM/LPIPS. The reference value is reported and compared; it does not decide status. LPIPS has no threshold by design -- a signal, never a verdict.
